title: 第3章 换房子第4章 请假了
lines: 第3章换房子
“妈，你拍我后脑勺干嘛？”
叶湘婷咬牙切齿，“觉醒成功就成功了，你好好的出来叹什么气！”
“检查的姐姐说我脑域波动大让我好好休息，可这中考只有20天了，这不是耽误我学习嘛。”乔桑一脸无辜。
“妈你干嘛！”
“你干嘛！”
说好的坚强女性呢！
原来站着的地方只留下跟乔桑一起出来的巧利果在风中凌乱。
“巧利！”
御兽中心禁止追赶喧哗！
一回到家，乔桑就将自己关在房间里打开电脑。
本身照母亲的意思是下午就去杭港宠兽基地挑选宠兽，但乔桑拒绝了。
御兽师作为这个世界的主流，挑选什么样的宠兽自然很重要，因为极可能人的一辈子只能契约一只宠兽。
御兽师的等级由低到高从f开始一直到sss为止。
f级的御兽师最简单，只要到15岁觉醒了御兽典契约一只宠兽就可以去御兽中心认证。
但要到e级御兽师就得先将脑域开发10%的程度，这样御兽典才能契约第二只宠兽。
然后还得培育出两只一段进化过的宠兽，也就是中级宠兽。
再由御兽联盟的公证人进行1v1战斗。
赢了才可以信息更改为e级御兽师。
有些人为了早点培育出中级宠兽，会选择进化周期较短的虫系超凡生物作为契约对象。
可才一段进化过的虫系宠兽毕竟太弱，能用它们赢得比赛的除了战斗指挥超强的御兽师，其他人根本不行。
原身作为学渣知识储备量实在不够，记住的超凡生物全是些光长得好看的。
长得好看有什么用，打架能赢吗？
不能打赢的话她怎么成为更高等级的御兽师？
选宠兽当然是选那些潜力高，战斗力强的。
要是下午就去杭港宠兽基地，她连那些宠兽的名字属性，一段二段进化后是什么都认不全，怎么选？
乔桑觉得这种事情急不得，还是得先做功课。
她打开论坛，登录自己的账号“天才又又又木”。
这个id充分证明每个学渣都有一个逆袭的梦。
乔桑没有选择发个新帖，这个世界的御兽观已经很成熟，每年都有成千上万刚觉醒的新人御兽师。
随便翻翻都有他们的各种帖子。
乔桑浏览着论坛，一眼扫下来全是跟宠兽有关的内容。
【我中了小多蝎的毒！】
content_en:
Chapter 3 Changing Houses
"Mom, why are you slapping me on the back of the head?"
Ye Xiangting gritted her teeth, "It's a success if the awakening is successful. Why are you sighing when you come out!"
"The sister who examined me said that my brain fluctuates greatly and I should have a good rest, but the high school entrance examination is only 20 days away. Isn't this delaying my study." Qiao Sang looked innocent.
Ye Xiangting: "..."
"Mom, what are you doing!"
"What are you doing!"
"Mom!"
What a strong woman you promised!
Where they stood, only the Qiao Liguo that came out with Qiao Sang was left messy in the wind.
"Qiaoli!"
Chasing and noise are prohibited at the Animal Control Center!
…
…
As soon as he got home, Qiao Sang locked himself in his room and turned on the computer.
I followed my mother's wishes and went to the Hangang Pet Beast Base in the afternoon to choose a pet, but Qiao Sang refused.
As the mainstream beast masters in this world, it is naturally very important what kind of pet beast they choose, because it is very likely that a person can only contract one pet beast in his life.
The levels of beastmasters range from low to high, starting from F and ending at SSS.
F-level beast masters are the simplest. As long as you awaken the beast master and contract a pet beast at the age of 15, you can go to the beast master center for certification.
But to reach the E-level beast master, you must first develop your brain to 10%, so that the beast master can contract a second pet beast.
Then you have to cultivate two evolved pet beasts, which are intermediate pet beasts.
Then the notary of the Beast Control Alliance will conduct a 1v1 battle.
Only after winning can the information be changed to E-level beast master.
In order to cultivate intermediate pet beasts as soon as possible, some people will choose insect-type extraordinary creatures with a short evolution cycle as contract partners.
However, the insect-type pets that have just evolved are too weak after all. Only the beast masters with strong combat command can use them to win the game, and no one else can win the game.
As a scumbag, the original person didn't have enough knowledge, and the extraordinary creatures he remembered were all just good-looking ones.
What's the use of looking good, can you win a fight?
How can she become a higher level beastmaster if she can't win?
Of course, when choosing pet beasts, you should choose those with high potential and strong combat effectiveness.
If she went to the Hanggang Pet Beast Base in the afternoon, she wouldn't even be able to recognize the names, attributes, and evolutions of those beasts. How could she choose?
Qiao Sang felt that there was no need to rush into this kind of thing, and he had to do his homework first.
She opened the forum and logged into her account "Genius and Wood".
This ID fully proves that every bad student has a dream of counterattack.
Qiao Sang did not choose to post a new post. The concept of beast masters in this world has been very mature, and there are thousands of new beast masters who have just awakened every year.
Just browse through their various posts.
Qiao Sang browsed the forum and saw at a glance all the content related to pet beasts.
[I have been poisoned by Xiao Duo Scorpion! 】
